page.layout: One printed page: running head at top with page number left and title right; a large engraved oval portrait with inscription around its rim; below the portrait, a four-line verse caption in italic type.

main_text.l: Haud minor Albani nostra saevitia mentis,
Iuliadum insontes populi hanc, & Westphala tellus
Et clivi sensere viri: sed criminis atri
Fama perennabit, vulgi & ferar improbus ore.

page.notes: The portrait is an engraved oval of Francisco A Mendoza, Admiral de Aragon, Marchese de Guadeles, &c., General of the Belgian forces, with the inscription around the rim: "FRANCISCVS A MENDOZA ADMIR. DE ARRAGON MARCH. GVADELES. ETC. GENERAL BELG." The engraving has no printed text of its own beyond this inscription. The first line of the caption is partly illegible at the line end; the word "tellus" is partly obscured; "ferar improbus ore" is uncertain at the line end. The title line and page number are read as printed; the running title is set in spaced capitals and is partly worn.
